field.label: Destination
field.help: Where individual queries are recorded. Files are written to /var/log/blocky/querylog and can be browsed from the Query Log page.

field.label: Retention
field.help: How many days of query logs to keep. Use 0 to keep them forever.

field.label: Fields
field.help: Which values are recorded. Omitted values are left blank rather than dropped, so the column layout stays the same.

field.label: Flush Interval
field.help: How often buffered entries are written out.
